title: Bobbin Winder Engaged
shortDescription: Bobbin winder shaft is pushed to the right.
fullDescription:
E1 indicates the bobbin winder spindle is engaged (pushed right), disabling the needle motor to prevent accidents.

Push spindle back to center position.

fixSteps.title: Disengage
fixSteps.instruction: Push bobbin winder spindle left to sewing position.

videoSearchQuery: Singer sewing E1 bobbin winder engaged

title: Foot Pedal Error
fullDescription:
E2 indicates the foot pedal is not connected, pressed at startup, or failing.

Check connection and ensure pedal is not depressed on power-on.

fixSteps.title: Check pedal
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug pedal, power machine, replug pedal.

videoSearchQuery: Singer sewing machine E2 foot pedal

faq.a: Some models have one; use instead.

title: Thread Jam
fullDescription:
E3 appears when motor senses resistance due to thread jam in the bobbin hook area.

Remove bobbin case, clear all thread, clean lint, rethread both top and bobbin.

fixSteps.title: Remove jam
fixSteps.instruction: Open bobbin cover, remove bobbin, clear tangled thread with tweezers.

fixSteps.title: Rethread
fixSteps.instruction: Rethread top and bobbin per manual.

videoSearchQuery: Singer sewing machine E3 thread jam clear

title: Needle Error
fullDescription:
E4 indicates the needle position sensor can't detect needle, or needle is broken/bent.

Replace the needle and check sensor.

fixSteps.title: Replace needle
fixSteps.instruction: Install new needle correct way, flat side back.

fixSteps.title: Test
fixSteps.instruction: Hand-turn wheel to verify smooth motion.

videoSearchQuery: Singer sewing machine E4 needle error

faq.a: Match to fabric type: 80/12 for most.

title: Buttonhole Lever Error
shortDescription: Buttonhole lever not in correct position.
fullDescription:
E5 appears when buttonhole mode is selected but the buttonhole lever is not lowered (or vice versa).

Lower or raise lever depending on stitch selected.

causes.cause: Lever not lowered in buttonhole mode

fixSteps.title: Adjust lever
fixSteps.instruction: Lower buttonhole lever for buttonhole stitches; raise for others.

videoSearchQuery: Singer sewing machine E5 buttonhole lever

title: Motor Overload
fullDescription:
E6 indicates motor overload protection engaged. Usually caused by sewing too-thick fabric or mechanical bind.

Remove fabric, rest machine, then use thicker needle for heavier materials.

fixSteps.title: Rest machine
fixSteps.instruction: Power off, let motor cool 10 min.

whenToCallPro: If error persists with light fabric.
videoSearchQuery: Singer sewing machine E6 motor overload

title: Presser Foot Error
fullDescription: E7 alerts when you try to sew with presser foot raised. Lower the foot before sewing.
videoSearchQuery: Singer sewing machine E7 presser foot

title: System / Memory Error
fullDescription: E8 is a generic internal fault. Reset by power cycling. If persists, may need firmware update or service.

faq.a: Usually not; custom patterns may be lost.

title: Needle Not in Up Position
shortDescription: Needle must be in up position for this operation.
fullDescription:
Some operations (like changing foot, switching stitches) require needle up. The machine alerts you when it isn't.

Use handwheel or up/down button to raise needle.

fixSteps.title: Raise needle
fixSteps.instruction: Press needle up/down button or turn handwheel toward you.

videoSearchQuery: Singer sewing machine needle up error

title: Buttonhole Sensor / Foot Error
shortDescription: Buttonhole foot not attached or sensor issue.
fullDescription:
One-step buttonhole requires the buttonhole foot with button clamp. Error means foot is missing or sensor can't read button size.

Attach correct foot with button in holder.

fixSteps.title: Install buttonhole foot
fixSteps.instruction: Attach buttonhole foot, place button in rear clamp.

fixSteps.title: Lower buttonhole lever
fixSteps.instruction: Pull lever down to full position.
